baseline.equivalence_test: all selector arms receive the identical registered Top-50 and Answer Scorer fields

core_invariants: The two registered 50-question source studies and rank-aligned Silver vote bundle define the 100-case input.
TREG and ECAD never receive Silver/gold labels, generated answers, or evaluator output at selection time.
TREG uses one fixed Reader identity and the declared gain(p|B4) arithmetic.
ECAD uses all 1225 rank-ordered pairs per question with one fixed three-way NLI identity.
Generator, evaluator, retrieval, and production selector interfaces remain unchanged.
Compact GitHub artifacts contain no raw question, passage, answer, evidence, prediction, or selected/retrieved id fields.

plugins.insertion_point: after case loading and before selector calls
after case loading and before selector calls

plugins.insertion_point: after all selections and post-hoc diagnostics

composition.merge_rule: one registered Top-50 is fanned out to QORE, Top-k, TREG, and ECAD; Silver labels are read only after selection

checks: TREG gain arithmetic and B4 identity

limitations: Silver oracle alignment is L0 diagnostic evidence, not gold utility or L1/L2 evidence.
The replay does not run the Generator and cannot establish EM/F1 improvement.
A positive replay is only a gate for a later frozen-Generator screen.
